$doc: THE single place the embedded runtime version and the per-native ABI/NAPI expectations live. Bumping the runtime = editing this file; harvest, compile and verify all read it. Package VERSIONS are deliberately absent — they come from package-lock.json, which is exact where package.json floats (sharp ^0.34.5, sqlite-vec ^0.1.9). Values recorded by the BIN-1 spike (single-binary mini-spec 2a, wigolo-studio-run#502).

runtime.source: nodejs.org official downloads — never the build host's node (that is what shipped an unredistributable runtime in SD-234-1)

toolchain.$doc: esbuild MUST be invoked with --supported:dynamic-import=false. Spike 2a build-fact 1: six runtime-fatal import() calls survived with ZERO warnings at --log-level=verbose. A post-build grep for surviving `import(` is a hard gate, not a nicety.

runtimeTarballSha256.$doc: Official nodejs.org archives, as downloaded 2026-09-07. The compile slice verifies the download against these before postject touches it.

natives.$doc: abiKind decides what harvest can ASSERT about a fetched artifact. `node-abi`: the asset name embeds the runtime ABI, so the ABI is checkable byte-for-byte. `napi`: runtime-independent within a NAPI level — checkable only where upstream DECLARES the level, hence the explicit nulls rather than a guessed number. `sqlite-extension`: SQLite's ABI, not Node's, so the runtime version is irrelevant to it.

better-sqlite3.abiNote: node-gyp addon. The GitHub release asset is named better-sqlite3-v<version>-node-v<abi>-<platform>-<arch>.tar.gz, so runtime.abi appears in the URL and a mismatch cannot be silent.

sqlite-vec.abiNote: A SQLite loadable extension (vec0.<dylib|so|dll>), not a Node addon. Runtime-ABI-independent; per-platform npm packages exist for all five targets.

onnxruntime-node.abiNote: napiVersion is upstream's own declaration (package.json binary.napi_versions). One npm package carries bin/napi-v3/{darwin,linux,win32}/{arm64,x64} — six runtimes — so harvest SLICES the pair for the target instead of staging the package.

sharp.abiNote: NAPI addon in @img/sharp-<target>, with its libvips in a sibling @img/sharp-libvips-<target> on the platforms that have one. Upstream declares no NAPI level, so none is asserted — the sibling set is derived from the platform package's own optionalDependencies in the lockfile, never from a hardcoded per-platform rule.

@napi-rs/keyring.abiNote: NAPI addon in @napi-rs/keyring-<napi-triple>. Optional: the OS keychain tier degrades cleanly under npm already, and must degrade the same way here — an absent cell is recorded, never a failed build.

wreq-js.abiNote: Native TLS-impersonation fetch tier. One package ships rust/wreq-js.<triple>.node for every target, so harvest slices one file. glibc only — mini-spec 1 puts musl/Alpine out of the matrix, so the -musl triples are never harvested even though the package carries them.
